usable_improvement: Reusable opt-in read-only outfit suggestion view in actual Showcase, accessed through ?suggestions=1; request explanation and dismissal while current look remains owned by existing controls.
research_question: Does the real caller afford a clear request/read/dismiss interaction and preserve clothes/settings/store on desktop and narrow mobile without stale owner references?
decision: Retain optional UI only if independent complete source review, one build and actual desktop request/dismiss plus mobile observation support it. Otherwise preserve isolated candidate/evidence and decline delivery.

contract.caller: Current Avatar remains owner. Resolve live wardrobe for every synchronous request; CatalogueDresser receives copied existing SHOWCASE_OUTFITS. No agency/store/profile/mood/pin/apply creation.
contract.view: Reusable callback-only component uses native details/select/buttons, textContent, explicit labels, polite status, dismissal focus; no fetch/storage/renderer/assets. Busy/export/failure gate and stale-card clearing.
contract.isolation: Only query suggestions=1 mounts view; ordinary appearance/presets/assets/settings schema unchanged. Do not promote wider agency/fit acceptance.
contract.lifetime: Controller owns DOM/listeners only. Current nonpersisted pagehide disposes it; persisted pagehide retains it. Never dispose borrowed wardrobe/Avatar/Stage.
contract.references: At most one current official MDN native details primary page if useful. Save response; no broad examples/image generation needed for this existing design language.
contract.verification: Root complete changed source + independent critic source verdict before execution. One bounded Vite build (120s). Root serializes one desktop tab and one mobile tab, original captures, request/dismiss preservation data; close only owned tabs. No mirrored unit test.
contract.stop: 45min hard effort bound. Stop native on unsupported state/render/error rather than repeat captures/epochs. Pre-native proved source defects may be corrected with exact original retained and full source re-review. No post-native cosmetic tuning without a separate decision.
